title: PRE Group and Hilton Unveil Major Egypt Expansion with 10 New Hotels and Branded Residences
summary: Up to 2,000 hotel rooms and branded residences will be added across Ain Sokhna, the North Coast, and New Cairo.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **PRE Group and Hilton announce six hotels and four branded residential developments in Egypt.**
- **Up to 2,000 hotel rooms and branded residences will be added across Ain Sokhna, the North Coast, and New Cairo.**
- **Spanning five Hilton brands, the agreement marks the debut of Canopy Hotels in the North Coast and Hilton’s entry into Ain Sokhna.**


**CAIRO, Egypt –** PRE Group and[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) announced the signing of six hotels and four branded residential developments, bringing up to 2,000 hotel rooms and branded residences to Ain Sokhna, the North Coast, and New Cairo.


Waleed Zaki, founder and CEO, PRE Group, and Guy Hutchinson, president, Middle East & Africa, Hilton, signed the agreement in the presence of His Excellency, Prime Minister H.E. Dr. Mostafa Madbouly, ministers, officials, and representatives from both companies.


The agreement represents a significant expansion of Hilton’s portfolio in Egypt, broadening its presence across established and emerging leisure and urban destinations. Spanning five brands across Hilton’s lifestyle, full-service and upscale segments, the developments will bring Canopy Hotels, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, Hilton Hotels & Resorts, DoubleTree by Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn to PRE Group’s destinations of Telal Ain Sokhna, Jebal Ain Sokhna, Telal El Alamein and Ivoire East. The partnership marks the debut of Canopy Hotels in the North Coast and Hilton’s entry into Ain Sokhna.


Waleed Zaki, founder and CEO, PRE Group, said, “Our expansion into the hospitality sector, through our partnership with a global hospitality operator of Hilton’s scale, builds on our group’s legacy and expertise in the Egyptian market. It reflects our vision of developing an integrated hotel portfolio to world-class standards. In collaboration with our partners at Hilton, we have selected a diverse range of its global brands to align with the nature and location of each project and meet the needs of different customer segments, delivering the most suitable brand and experience for every destination.”


He added, “Significant investment in infrastructure, transport links, and airports have helped create new opportunities for private-sector investments across the hotel and hospitality sectors. We aim to build on the experiences of successful markets that have positioned tourism as a key driver of economic growth. Our new projects will play an active role in delivering exceptional hospitality experiences that strengthen the competitiveness of Egypt’s destinations.”


Carlos Khneisser, chief development officer, Middle East & Africa, Hilton, said, “Egypt has been part of Hilton’s story for more than 65 years, and we continue to see significant opportunities for growth across the country. Our partnership with PRE Group reflects our shared confidence in the future of Egypt’s tourism sector and enables us to bring the right brands and experiences to destinations with distinct growth potential. It also marks a further step in extending Hilton’s hospitality beyond the hotel stay and into homeownership. Together, these developments will strengthen our presence in key locations and introduce more guests and residence owners to Hilton’s world-class hospitality.”


The agreement supports the country’s efforts to develop the hotel sector and achieve its national targets. Egypt’s national tourism strategy aims to increase hotel capacity to approximately 300,000 rooms and attract nearly 30 million tourists annually by 2030.


All hotels and branded residences will be part of Hilton Honors, Hilton’s award-winning loyalty programme with over 260 million members globally. For more development news, visit[Stories from Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/emea) .


##### FAQ: PRE Group and Hilton Announce Strategic Partnership in Egypt


PRE Group and Hilton have announced a strategic partnership for six hotels and four branded residential developments in Egypt. The portfolio will add up to 2,000 hotel rooms and branded residences.


The developments will be located across Ain Sokhna, the North Coast and New Cairo, within PRE Group’s Telal Ain Sokhna, Jebal Ain Sokhna, Telal El Alamein, and Ivoire East destinations.


The portfolio will span five Hilton brands including Canopy Hotels, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, Hilton Hotels & Resorts, DoubleTree by Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn.


---


## About Hilton


Hilton (Nasdaq: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named a three-time No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone. Visit[stories.hilton.com](http://stories.hilton.com/) for more information, and connect with Hilton on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/hiltonnewsroom) ,[X](https://twitter.com/hiltonnewsroom) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hilton/) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hiltonnewsroom/) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/hilton) .


---


## About PRE Group


PRE Group entered the Egyptian market in 2007 and has since become one of the country’s leading real estate developers, listed on the Egyptian Exchange. The Group has established itself as a trusted partner in developing integrated communities built on three core pillars: superior quality, continuous innovation and strategic locations. Its subsidiaries bring more than 120 years of combined experience in real estate development, management and investment. With a strategic land bank exceeding 12 million sqm, PRE Group’s footprint spans across Greater Cairo, the North Coast, Ain Sokhna, Alexandria, and Marsa Alam. Through 16 residential, commercial and coastal projects, PRE Group is redefining integrated living in Egypt, guided by a vision focused on sustainability, added investment value, and pioneering living experiences. To date, PRE Group has delivered more than 10,200 units. For more information, visit[pregroup-eg.com](https://pregroup-eg.com/) .
